svg.title: The fastest trip, the one with least walking and the one without a transfer from Olinda to Boa Viagem
svg.desc: A map of Olinda and Recife with three trips by bus from Praça do Carmo, in Olinda, to Praça de Boa Viagem, in the south of Recife, and beside it their time, transfers and walking. The fastest takes 72 minutes with one transfer and 6 minutes on foot; with 2 minutes on foot and one transfer, 76 minutes; a single bus, without a transfer, takes 84 minutes.

g.text: Streets © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), Geofabrik extract of 2026-11-01. Timetables: Grande Recife Consórcio de Transporte
From Praça do Carmo (A) to Praça de Boa Viagem (B): the trips that no other beats on time, transfers
and walking at once (trip_options), leaving at 07:20 on Tuesday 10 November 2026. Solid: on the bus;
dotted: on foot. Fares are not a criterion: the feed does not say which transfers are free
Three ways from Olinda to Boa Viagem at 07:20
